create_experimental_decorator: create a decorator that flags a function as experimental and emits a UserWarning on invocation
test_experimental_warning: test that the experimental decorator emits a UserWarning when the decorated function is called
refactor_experimental_class: refactor the experimental decorator to handle class __new__ methods by stripping the qualname suffix
review_experimental_env_var: review how the experimental decorator respects HF_HUB_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING environment variable
summarize_experimental_usage: summarize the experimental decorator usage for flagging functions subject to breaking changes
